verdict.rationale: LightSprint is an agent-orchestration SaaS, so issuing scoped agent credentials is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never mentions issuing API tokens or keys of any kind, scoped or otherwise. The adjacent controls it does document are GitHub-mapped merge permissions, sandbox egress control, model-gateway routing, bring-your-own model keys and secret scrubbing. None of these amounts to minting least-privilege credentials for an agent, and the OpenAPI probes found no public API surface.
